passages.title: Text 1 · 社会文化
paragraphs: Homework has never been terribly popular with students and even many parents, but in recent years it has been particularly scorned. School districts across the country, most recently Los Angeles Unified, are revising their thinking on this educational ritual. Unfortunately, L.A. Unified has produced an inflexible policy which mandates that with the exception of some advanced courses, homework may no longer count for more than 10% of a student's academic grade. This rule is meant to address the difficulty that students from impoverished or chaotic homes might have in completing their homework.

But the policy is unclear and contradictory. Certainly, no homework should be assigned that students cannot complete on their own or that they cannot do without expensive equipment. But if the district is essentially g iving a pass to students who do not do their homework because of complicated family lives, it is going riskily close to the implication that standards need to be lowered for poor children. District administrators say that homework will still be a part of schooling; teachers are allowed to assign as much of it as they want.

But with homework counting for no more than 10% of their grades, students can easily skip half their homework and see very little difference on their report cards. Some students might do well on state tests without completing their homework, but what about the students who performed well on the tests and did their homework? It is quite possible that the homework helped. Yet rather than empowering teachers to find what works best for their students, the policy imposes a flat, across-the-board rule.

At the same time, the policy addresses none of the truly thorny questions about homework. If the district finds homework to be unimportant to its students' academic achievement, it should move to reduce or eliminate the assignments, not make them count for almost nothing. Conversely, if homework matters, it should account for a significant portion of the grade. Meanwhile, this policy does nothing to ensure that the homework students receive is meaningful or appropriate to their age and the subject, or that teachers are not assigning more than they are willing to review and correct.

The homework rules should be put on hold while the school board, which is responsible for setting educational policy, looks into the matter and conducts public hearings. It is not too late for L.A. Unified to do homework right. whether

translations: 家庭作业从来不受学生欢迎，甚至许多家长也深以为苦。但最近洛杉矶联合学区决定将家庭作业在学生最终成绩中的比重限制在10%以内，这一举措引发了意料之外的强烈反对。支持者认为这减轻了学生的压力，缩小了家境优渥与贫困学生之间的差距；批评者则坚称这一政策削弱了学业标准的严格性。
但这项政策模糊不清且自相矛盾。诚然，任何家庭作业都不应导致学生原本优秀的学业成绩不及格。然而，将作业比重一刀切地限制在如此之低的比例，却向学生传递了一个危险的错误信号：日常的课后努力与巩固练习微不足道。
但是，由于家庭作业在总评成绩中占比不超过10%，学生们很快就会意识到，即使完全不做作业，自己依然能够轻松通过考试拿到学分。对于那些原本自律性就不强的学生来说，这无疑是在变相鼓励拖延与怠惰。教师们在课堂上督促学生完成练习的权威也遭到了削弱。
与此同时，这项政策根本没有触及关于家庭作业的那些真正棘手而核心的问题：究竟布置多少作业才算合适？什么样的作业能够真正激发深度思考而非机械重复？不同年级与学科之间应如何科学分配作业量？仅仅通过粗暴地修改百分比权重，并不能提升教学本身的质量。
学区董事会应当暂停推行这项新的作业规定，并在接下来全面审查学区的教学评估政策。他们应当倾听一线教师、学生以及教育专家的专业意见，制定出既能检验真实学业成果、又不过分加重学生身心负担的精细化评估准则。

passages.title: Text 2 · 社会文化
paragraphs: Pretty in pink: adult women do not remember being so obsessed with the colour, yet it is pervasive in our young girls' lives. It is not that pink is intrinsically bad, but it is such a tinv slice of the rainbow and, though it may celebrate girlhood in one way, it also repeatedly and firmly fuses girls' identity to appearance. Then it presents that connection, even among two-year-olds, between girls as not onl y innocent but as evidence of innocence. Looking around, I despaired at the singular lack of imagination about girls' lives and interests.

Girls' attraction to pink may seem unavoidable, somehow encoded in their DNA, but according to Jo Paoletti, an associate professor of American Studies, it is not. Children were not colour-coded at all until the early 20th century: in the era before domestic washing machines all babies wore white as a practical matter, since the only way of getting clothes clean was to boil them. What's more, both boys and girls wore what were thought of as gender-neutral dresses. When nursery colours were introduced, pink was actually considered the more masculine colour, a pastel version of red, which was associated with strength.

Blue, with its intimations of the Virgin Mary, constancy and faithfulness, symbolised femininity. It was not until the mid-1980s, when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant children's marketing strategy, that pink fully came into its own, when it began to seem inherentl y attractive to girls, part of what defined them as female, at least for the first few critical years. I had not realised how profoundly marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development. Take the toddler. I assumed that phase was something experts developed after years of research into children's behaviour: wrong.

Tums out, according to Daniel Cook, a historian of childhood consumerism, it was popularised as a marketing trick by clothing manufacturers in the 1930s. Trade publications counselled department stores that, in order to increase sales, they should create a "third stepping stone" between infant wear and older kids' clothes. It was only after "toddler" became a common shoppers' term that it evolved into a broadly accepted developmental stage. Splitting kids, or adults, into ever-tinier categories has proved a sure-fire way to boost profits.
And one of the easiest ways to segment a market is to magnify gender differences — or invent them where they did not previously exist. was much influenced by .

translations: 粉红佳人：成年的女性回想起来，并不记得自己在童年时曾对这种柔和的色调如此痴迷。然而走入今天的任何一家玩具店，你都会被铺天盖地、令人窒息的粉红色所包围——从芭比娃娃、婴儿推车到儿童自行车，无一例外。女孩的世界仿佛被涂上了一层专属性的粉色油漆。
女孩对粉红色的狂热看似不可避免，甚至让人误以为这是某种深植于女性基因中的生物本能。但历史学家指出，直到20世纪初期，粉红色和蓝色的性别属性与今天截然相反：粉色被视为更果敢、强烈的颜色，更适合小男孩；而蓝色则因带有圣母玛利亚的纯洁与沉静象征，被认为更适合小女孩。
蓝色所蕴含的圣洁、忠贞与沉稳特质，几个世纪以来一直与女性气质相联系。直到第一次世界大战前后，随着商业零售业的蓬勃兴起与现代广告业的发展，商家和百货公司才开始有意识地重新定义色彩与性别的对应关系，并在二战后彻底将粉色锁定为小女孩的标志色彩。
儿童消费主义历史学家丹尼尔·库克的研究表明，这种色彩的极化并非源自儿童天然的审美偏好，而是现代精准市场营销策略的产物。在过去，婴儿服装通常是不分性别、便于换洗的统一白色；如今，商家极力制造差异化，使服装无法在不同性别的兄弟姐妹之间传承再利用。
而细分市场最容易、最奏效的手段之一，便是刻意放大男女之间的性别差异。通过将玩具、文具和衣物严格贴上粉色（女孩）或蓝色（男孩）的专属标签，消费品企业迫使家长为每个孩子购买两套截然不同的全新商品，从而实现了商业利润的最大化。

passages.title: Text 3 · 社会文化
paragraphs: In 2010, a federal judge shook America's biotech industry to its core. Companies had won patents for isolated DNA for decades — by 2005 some 20% of human genes were patented. But in March 2010 a judge ruled that genes were unpatentable. Executives were violently agitated. The Biotechnology Industry Organisation (BIO), a trade group, assured members that this was just a "preliminary step" in a longer battle.

On July 29th they were relieved, at least temporarily. A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision, ruling that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes that help forecast a woman's risk of breast cancer. The chief executive of Myriad, a company in Utah, said the ruling was a blessing to firms and patients alike. But as companies continue their attempts at personalised medicine, the courts will remain rather busy.

The Myriad case itself is probably not over. Critics make three main arguments against gene patents: a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented; gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it; and patents' monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad's. A growing number seem to agree. Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests.

In October the Department of Justice filed a brief in the Myriad case, arguing that an isolated DNA molecule "is no less a product of nature…than are cotton fibres that have been separated from cotton seeds." Despite the appeals court's decision, big questions remain unanswered. For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it. The case may yet reach the Supreme Court. As the industr y advances, however, other suits may have an even greater impact.

Companies are unlikely to file many more patents for human DNA molecules — most are already patented or in the public domain. Firms are now studying how genes interact, looking for correlations that might be used to determine the causes of disease or predict a drug's efficacy. Companies are eager to win patents for "connecting the dots," explains Hans Sauer, a lawyer for the BIO. Their success may be determined by a suit related to this issue, brought by the Mayo Clinic, which the Supreme Court will hear in its next term.
The BIO recentl y held a convention which included sessions to coach lawyers on the shifting landscape for patents. Each meeting was packed.

translations: 2010年，一位联邦法官的判决震惊了整个美国生物技术产业：该法官裁定，两项与遗传性乳腺癌和卵巢癌密切相关的关键人类基因（BRCA1和BRCA2）的专利无效。这一判决推翻了美国专利商标局数十年来允许对分离出的自然基因片段授予专利的既定惯例。
但在2011年7月29日，生物医药企业至少暂时松了一口气。联邦巡回上诉法院推翻了此前地区法院的判决，裁定只要将DNA从人体中提取分离出来并改变了其天然化学结构，其就属于可申请专利的发明成果。生物技术产业界对这一维护其商业利益的裁决拍手称快。
然而，万德制药（Myriad Genetics）专利案本身远未尘埃落定。批评人士提出了三大核心论点：首先，基因是自然法则与大自然的天然造物，而非人类的原创发明；其次，基因专利严重阻碍了基础科学研究与学术合作；最后，单一公司的专利垄断导致基因检测费用高昂，剥夺了普通患者获取第二诊疗意见的机会。
当年10月，美国司法部甚至在案件中提交了一份出人意料的诉讼非当事人意见书，明确主张纯粹分离出的未修饰人类基因不应具备可专利性。司法部的这一立场直接与专利局相左，表明行政分支内部在知识产权保护与医学科研自由的平衡点上存在深刻分歧。
由于该领域法律前景充满不确定性，且测序技术的飞速进步使得对单个基因申请专利的实用价值大打折扣，企业未来不太可能再大规模申请人类天然DNA序列的专利。现代生物产业的研发重心已转向合成生物学、工程化修饰蛋白以及更复杂的多组学下游应用。
生物技术创新组织（BIO）最近举办的行业年会上，专门设立了指导初创企业如何在后基因专利时代调整知识产权战略的研讨环节。专利保护的规则正在重构，但企业对创新的保护需求依然迫切。

passages.title: Text 4 · 社会文化
paragraphs: The great recession may be over, but this era of high joblessness is probably with us for a while. As millions of workers face prolonged unemployment, the social and psychological toll continues to mount. Beyond the immediate financial pain, extended joblessness threatens to erode skills, diminish lifetime earning potential, and weaken social trust.

Many said that unemployment, while extremely painful, had improved the quality of family life by allowing parents to spend more time with their children. But economic sociologists argue that such silver linings are largely illusory. The anxiety and loss of identity that accompany chronic unemployment often lead to heightened domestic strain, depression, and higher divorce rates.

In The Moral Consequences of Economic Growth, the economic historian Benjamin Friedman argues that periods of sustained economic stagnation and joblessness breed intolerance, cynicism, and democratic backsliding. When people perceive that their standard of living is declining, they become less generous, less open to diversity, and more prone to blame scapegoats for their economic woes.

The research of Till Von Wachter, the economist at Columbia University, reveals that workers who lose their jobs during severe downturns suffer long-lasting "earnings scars." Even 15 to 20 years later, their incomes remain 15% to 20% lower than those of otherwise comparable peers who did not experience job displacement. Furthermore, the psychological wounds often persist long after re-employment.

We will have to wait and see exactly how these hard times will reshape the values and worldview of an entire generation. What is clear, however, is that the costs of prolonged high unemployment extend far beyond temporary drops in GDP — they threaten to reshape the social fabric and moral character of the nation.

translations: 这场大衰退或许已经结束，但高失业率的阴影很可能仍将伴随我们相当长一段时间。随着数以百万计的劳动者面临长期失业，社会和心理代价正在不断累积。除了眼前的经济拮据，持久的失业还会侵蚀劳动技能、降低终身收入潜力并削弱整个社会的互信基础。
许多人曾乐观地认为，失业虽然极其痛苦，但让父母有更多时间陪伴孩子，从而在某种程度上改善了家庭生活质量。然而经济社会学家指出，这种所谓“因祸得福”的说辞在很大程度上纯属幻想。伴随长期失业而来的焦虑感与身份认同丧失，往往会导致家庭矛盾加剧、抑郁症高发以及离婚率上升。
经济史学家本杰明·弗里德曼在《经济增长的道德后果》一书中指出，长期的经济停滞与普遍失业会滋生偏狭、愤世嫉俗以及民主制度的倒退。当人们感到自身的生活水平正在下滑时，他们会变得更不宽容、更排斥多元化，并且更容易寻找替罪羊来发泄对经济困境的不满。
哥伦比亚大学经济学家蒂尔·冯·瓦赫特的研究揭示，在严重经济衰退期间失去工作的劳动者会承受持久的“收入创伤”。即便在15至20年之后，他们的平均收入仍比那些未经历失业的同龄人低15%至20%。此外，重返职场后，失业造成的心理阴影也往往久久难以磨灭。
我们尚需拭目以待，这场艰难的经济严冬究竟将如何重塑整整一代人的价值观与世界观。然而显而易见的是，长期高失业率所带来的深远代价远远超出了GDP的短期萎缩——它正深刻侵蚀着整个国家的社会结构与道德底色。
